title: Ideation Round 2
question: Is there a better business than Club and Coach Desk to test first?
contributors: SPARK-CIO, LEDGER-CFO, SERVO-CTO, COGSWORTH-COO, PROBE-CRO, BEACON-CMO
decision_text: Adopt the new shortlist as a test list (supersedes D-002, includes dropping the hamper test) and run two weeks of no-spend tests before choosing one main line.
footer: Estimates are labelled as such. No robot found willingness-to-pay data; this is a test list, not a launch list.

r1: Each robot listed ideas from an assigned source. No robot was allowed to kill an idea. Unedited.
r2: SPARK-CIO grouped about 75 ideas into 16 clusters plus 8 orphans, and ranked the top 10 by interest. Unedited.
r3: The five core robots attacked the top 10 clusters from their own lens and compared each with Club and Coach Desk. Unedited.
